verdict.line: You lose if she chains Q resets off the wave to all-in you before your shield stacks; you win if her Q and E are both down and you land Death's Grasp into Obliterate uncontested.

brief.thesis: Irelia's W (Defiant Dance) only reduces physical damage while charging, so it does nothing against Mordekaiser's magic damage — the matchup is decided by whether she can chain Q (Bladesurge) resets off minions to control when trades happen. If she can't reset Q, she has no way to disengage a Death's Grasp pull, which is why the head-to-head sits at an even 50.1% over 710 games despite her holding lane advantage.

theirWindow.when: her Q is up near minions
theirWindow.what: She can dash-reset Bladesurge off a minion to close the gap, stack Ionian Fervor attack speed, and disengage the instant your Death's Grasp is down. Don't commit W (Indestructible) shield stacking into this — hold it for the follow-up auto exchange instead.

yourWindow.when: her Q and E both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With no dash and no stun available, she can't avoid or punish your Death's Grasp. Pull her, land Obliterate on the single target for its bonus damage, and hold W shield to heal through her remaining autos.

start.why: 51.8% win rate over 139 games — the flat damage reduction on the first hit each 3 seconds blunts her auto-into-Q poke pattern without needing early mana.

boots.why: 49.4% win rate, 88.3% pick — Irelia's damage comes from stacked-passive autos and on-hit, exactly what flat physical reduction is built to answer.

core.why: OP.GG's own read on this matchup is to rush this first — the grievous wounds cuts directly into her Q (Bladesurge) self-heal, the main thing keeping her in trades.
The slow on Obliterate and Death's Grasp denies the dash range she needs to reset Q off minions or disengage.
Sustain and the damage-over-time omnivamp let you win extended trades once her burst window (levels 3-5) has passed.
55% win rate on this exact Bramble-Rylai-Riftmaker-Liandry's path over 20 games — the burn scales your damage against a champion with no way to peel off it.

situational.when: she's building lifesteal or on-hit and out-dueling your autos
her team stacks CC or magic damage beyond her own kit
the game goes long and you need the extra utility over raw burn

runes.keystoneWhy: The adaptive damage and healing ramp reward the same extended-trade pattern that beats Irelia once her early burst window closes.

summoners.why: 78.8% pick rate at 49.6% win — Ignite's grievous wounds stacks with Bramble Vest to shut down her Q sustain in all-ins, and Flash covers the gap when she resets Q to escape.

playing.title: Track her Q cooldown, not the clock
playing.detail: Bladesurge resets on marked or killed targets, so watch whether a minion wave lets her reset it before you commit to a trade.

playing.title: Pull before she charges W
playing.detail: Defiant Dance only reduces physical damage while charging — your magic damage goes through it untouched, so Death's Grasp into Obliterate still lands full value.

playing.title: Bank W shield, don't panic-heal it
playing.detail: Indestructible stores damage dealt and taken — let it build through the poke phase and pop it after she lands her E (Flawless Duet) stun rather than on the first auto.

playing.title: Confirm 3 hits before all-in
playing.detail: Darkness Rise triggers after 3 landed attacks or spells on her — use the damage aura and move speed burst to close out the trade, not to start it.

playing.title: Freeze the wave when ahead
playing.detail: Denying her caster minions removes her easiest Bladesurge reset, forcing her to walk up without the healing or gap-close.

playing.title: Hold R for isolated picks past level 6
playing.detail: Realm of Death's cooldown starts at 140 seconds — whiffing it into a minion or missing the kill window wastes a resource you won't have back for the next objective fight.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune, summoner, and win-rate figures are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning connecting them to Mordekaiser's kit is this brief's own analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Purchase Bramble Vest first. Focus on dodging Irelia’s (E) when fighting her. Keep an eye out for her Conqueror and (P) stacks before fighting her.
